name: Checkmate Lounge: Watch Party with Play Along - Bangalore Chess Club
description:
The World Chess Championship is here, and we're cheering for **Gukesh** as he takes on **Javokhir Sindarov**!

Come watch the match live on the big screen with fellow chess fans, and don't just watch: grab a board and play along. Throughout the evening, we'll be playing fun chess variants like knockout games, dice chess, hand and brain, bughouse, antichess and a simul.

Discuss the moves, predict what comes next, and cheer every brilliant idea together. Whether you're a seasoned player or simply love the game, come for the chess and stay for the community.

**Note:** Kids are welcome, but must be accompanied by a parent.
